title: amdgpu: screen randomly displays noise/static on high refresh rates
body: Just got a new laptop, and I'm experiencing issues at high refresh rates where the screen will randomly be filled with noise for a handful of frames before going back to normal. My laptop is a Tuxedo Computers InfinityBook Pro Gen10 (AMD) with the AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 CPU & integrated graphics (AMD Radeon 890M). interestingly, when this happens, nothing gets logged to the
